facts_verified.claim: The workflow accepts only the exact execute token and expected main SHA, verifies current origin/main, owner actor and triggering actor, and globally rejects a previous owner dispatch before secrets are exposed.
A signed 39-file LF-normalized attestation is verified before runtime construction; the runtime imports only copied attested source and all five workflow Python invocations use isolated mode.

The workflow performs an OpenSSL CMS preflight before the secret-bearing capture step, scopes provider and R2 secrets to that step, uses restrictive filesystem permissions, deletes plaintext staging on exit, and uploads only sanitized public evidence plus encrypted private delivery.

Success, partial failure after a dispatched call, and zero-valid-capture cases all produce a public receipt and encrypted private bundle while the sentinel job prevents a misleading green workflow on PARTIAL.

unknowns: GitHub runner availability, provider reachability, and R2 availability can only be observed during the single authorized post-merge dispatch.
assumptions: The existing repository secrets retain the values and permissions required by the reviewed workflow.
The local recipient private key remains available until delivery verification finishes.
main_objection: No P0 or P1 platform defect blocks the frozen candidate. The continuation grants zero runtime-effect increment; merge and the parent-authorized dispatch remain conditional on exact-head CI, unchanged signed runtime bytes, the certificate validity window and the owner-side delivery verification described below.

risks.risk: The short-lived recipient certificate expires on 2026-10-04, so delayed execution would fail closed before secrets rather than produce a private delivery.
GitHub artifact retention is not the durable raw-data store; delivery must be downloaded and verified while R2 remains the immutable source of raw evidence.

The private report status describes capture validation, whereas public-receipt.json describes end-to-end delivery status after the final R2 report readback. If they differ on a failure path, the public receipt is authoritative and the run remains PARTIEL.
Post-download integrity and cross-format row equivalence are owner-side acceptance steps rather than workflow assertions. They are mandatory before the decrypted table can be reported as verified.

minimum_decisive_test: Require all four exact-head required checks, verify the certificate and signed attestation again, then permit one and only one workflow dispatch from merged main.
recommended_action: PASS_AND_HOLD for exact-head CI and normal merge, followed by the single authorized dispatch before certificate expiry.
scale_condition: No rerun and no additional dispatch; any runner, certificate, secret, provider, or storage ambiguity produces PARTIAL or FAIL_AND_STOP.
estimated_compute: Read-only workflow, signature, import-closure, and failure-path inspection plus focused tests and static checks.
estimated_external_cost: 0 during review; no cloud write, secret read, provider request, or purchase was performed.
estimated_human_time: Independent bounded platform review completed within the mission budget.
maintenance_impact: Moderate but bounded: attested hashes and certificate material must be regenerated together after any runtime-byte change.
